# Times Food - Recipes & Food

> India's largest online recipe platform with 10,000+ homemade recipes, videos, and food content spanning Indian cuisine, street food, festive dishes, and healthy cooking.

Times Food is the food vertical of Times of India, offering comprehensive recipe collections organized by occasion, cuisine type, and meal course. The site specializes in Indian recipes including traditional fasting foods, regional specialties, street food chaats, and contemporary healthy options with step-by-step cooking guides.

## Key Topics

- Indian cuisine
- homemade recipes
- vegetarian recipes
- street food chaat
- fasting food
- Navratri recipes
- snack recipes
- easy recipes
- beverage recipes
- Indian street food
- Kuttu recipes
- Palak Paneer
- Aloo Paratha
- Kadhai Chicken
- Rasgulla

## Core Recipe Collections

- [Times Food Homepage](https://recipes.timesofindia.com): Times Food homepage with 10,000+ recipes, videos, and food content
- [Browse All Recipes](https://recipes.timesofindia.com/recipes): Times Food recipe collection browse by occasion, cuisine, course
- [Dinner Recipes](https://recipes.timesofindia.com/recipes/dinner-recipes/52518344): Collection of easy dinner recipes and quick meal ideas
- [Recipes by Occasion](https://recipes.timesofindia.com/recipes/occasions): Browse recipes organized by occasion for meal planning

## Fasting & Festive Recipes

- [Kuttu ka Paratha](https://recipes.timesofindia.com/recipes/kuttu-ka-paratha/articleshow/82078549.cms): Step-by-step guide to make Kuttu ka Paratha with buckwheat flour
- [Kuttu Ka Cheela](https://recipes.timesofindia.com/recipes/kuttu-ka-cheela/articleshow/78947889.cms): Easy Kuttu Ka Cheela breakfast recipe with buckwheat flour
- [Kuttu Paneer Kofta](https://recipes.timesofindia.com/recipes/kuttu-paneer-kofta/articleshow/63376769.cms): Homemade Kuttu Paneer Kofta recipe with step-by-step instructions
- [Kuttu Singhara Halwa](https://recipes.timesofindia.com/recipes/kuttu-singhara-halwa/articleshow/94541088.cms): Traditional Kuttu Singhara Halwa fasting dessert recipe
- [Navratri Sweet Potato Ladoos](https://recipes.timesofindia.com/recipes/navratri-sweet-potato-ladoos/articleshow/60806965.cms): Navratri festive sweet potato ladoos dessert recipe
- [Navratri Vrat Suran Chips](https://recipes.timesofindia.com/recipes/navratri-vrat-suran-chips/articleshow/60807404.cms): Navratri fasting Suran chips snack recipe for festivals
